'''Ko Sai'''<ref name="TVE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> was a [[Kaminoan]]<ref name="CVD" /> who was a [[Chief Scientist|chief scientist]]<ref name="Grand Army Encyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Grand Army of the Republic (reference book)}}</ref> during the [[Republic Era|Fall of the Republic]]. When [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was given a tour of the [[Tipoca City Military Complex]] by [[Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su]] and [[Aide]] [[Taun We]], Sai was supervising a group of [[Clone trooper|clone]] [[Clone cadet|cadets]]. Sai wore a [[Color|white]] and black uniform.<ref name="CVD" />
